other_conditions: The enterprise must be a new micro, small or medium enterprise engaged in manufacturing, service or trading activities
The enterprise must have availed a Term Loan and/or Working Capital Loan
Operations/production must have commenced on or after 01/04/2022
The unit must have a valid Udyam Registration
Loan accounts must not be classified as NPA at the time of claim submission
The unit must be operational at the time of application
The unit must not have received any grant assistance under any Central, State or Local government scheme, except for units covered under the PMFME scheme as described
Units supported under the PMFME scheme are eligible for the working‑capital portion up to ₹10 lakh if they commenced production after expansion/modernisation/diversification on or after 01/04/2022
benefits_summary: Interest subvention of up to 6% (difference between bank rate and 4%) on loans up to ₹10 lakh for a five‑year period.
documents_required: Relevant documents submitted with the application to the Recommending Authority
